name: Noroxymorphone
summary: Noroxymorphone is an opioid which is both a metabolite of oxymorphone and oxycodone and is manufactured specifically as an intermediate in the production of opioid antagonists such as naltrexone and others. It is a potent agonist of the μ-opioid receptor, but is poorly able to cross the blood–brain barrier into the central nervous system, and for this reason, has only minimal analgesic activity.
